scene.ko: 뉴욕 · 싱가포르 · 서울에 있는 사람들의 일정을 맞춰 금요일 전에 킥오프 회의를 잡는다.

lines.en: Have you found a time for the kickoff meeting? We really need everyone together before Friday.
lines.ko: 킥오프 회의 시간 찾았어요? 금요일 전에는 꼭 모두 모여야 해요.

lines.en: I'm working on it, but it's been a bit tricky. Ken is in New York and Priya is in Singapore, so the time difference is a challenge.
lines.ko: 지금 맞추는 중인데 좀 까다롭네요. 켄은 뉴욕에, 프리야는 싱가포르에 있어서 시차가 문제예요.
alt: I'm still working on it. With Ken in New York and Priya in Singapore, the time difference makes it hard.

lines.en: Can't we just pick a time that works for us and ask them to adjust?
lines.ko: 그냥 우리한테 맞는 시간으로 정하고 그쪽에 맞춰 달라고 하면 안 될까요?

lines.en: I'd rather not. Ken has already had several late-night calls this month. I was thinking Wednesday at 8 a.m. our time, which is 6 p.m. Tuesday for him.
lines.ko: 그건 좀 피하고 싶어요. 켄이 이번 달에 이미 늦은 밤 통화를 여러 번 했거든요. 우리 시간으로 수요일 아침 8시를 생각하고 있었는데, 켄한테는 화요일 저녁 6시예요.
alt: I'd prefer not to. Ken has had a lot of late calls this month. How about Wednesday at 8 a.m. here? That's 6 p.m. Tuesday in New York.

lines.en: That makes sense. But wouldn't that be really early for Priya?
lines.ko: 그렇네요. 그런데 프리야한테는 너무 이르지 않을까요?

lines.en: It would be 7 a.m. for her. I already checked, and she said that's fine, as long as she can leave the call by eight her time.
lines.ko: 프리야는 아침 7시예요. 이미 물어봤는데, 그쪽 시간으로 8시까지 통화에서 나갈 수 있으면 괜찮대요.
alt: It'd be 7 a.m. there. I asked her, and she's okay with it if she can leave by eight.

lines.en: Okay. The only problem is, I have a call with head office at 8:30 on Wednesday.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 문제는 제가 수요일 8시 반에 본사와 통화가 있다는 거예요.

lines.en: Then would it work if we covered your topics in the first half hour? I can send you notes on the rest afterward.
lines.ko: 그럼 처음 30분 동안 팀장님 안건을 먼저 다루면 어떨까요? 나머지는 끝나고 정리해서 보내 드릴게요.
alt: Then could we go over your part first, in the first thirty minutes? I'll send you notes on the rest later.

lines.en: That would be perfect. Let's go with that.
Great. I'll send everyone an invitation with the start time for each city, so there's no confusion.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 헷갈리지 않게 도시별 시작 시간을 적어서 모두에게 초대장을 보낼게요.
alt: Great. I'll send out the invite with the time for each city so no one gets confused.

expressions.note: 대안을 내며 상대 의견을 물을 때 (동사는 과거형)
